fr_html: M. ADATCI trouve que les paroles du Président expriment la sagesse et la justice. Pour lui la chose est parfaitement claire; il faut faire une distinction entre les Etats Membres de la Société et les Etats non-membres. Il croit devoir approfondir cette question; il le fera au cours d'une prochaine séance.
en_html: M. ADATCI thought that the President's remarks were both wise and just. It was perfectly clear to him that a distinction must be drawn between States Members of the League and States which are not Members. He thought they must go more deeply into the question. He would do so at a future meeting.
